annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five likely believe this side track is dead today
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: believe this side track is dead today, no scheduled runs, nothing to fear
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I use that quiet trust of theirs to make my own choice easier
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: telling myself the numbers justify it
annotations.pda_responsibility: their unawareness became the very thing I leaned on

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The one worker probably expects that someone, somewhere, will step in
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: using his faith to spare my own guilt rather than to actually save him
annotations.pda_harm_regret: That feels like a theft I can't undo
annotations.pda_responsibility: using his faith to spare my own guilt

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think the five assume this stretch is unused, safe by habit
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: assume this stretch is unused, safe by habit
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: Their unspoming trust in that becomes my cover
annotations.pda_responsibility: what I'm choosing to do to them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The single man surely believes the operators know he's there
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: believes the operators know he's there, that protocol protects him
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I use that belief to quiet my own conscience
annotations.pda_responsibility: letting his confidence do the work my hesitation should have done

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five, I imagine, trust the schedule completely
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: trust the schedule completely, expecting no train on their track today
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: That expectation becomes something I use to make the decision bearable
annotations.ce_understood_harm: it costs them the one thing they didn't know to guard against
annotations.pda_responsibility: I carry that weight without pretending it's clean

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The one man likely believes there's still time
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I use that belief to soften my own hesitation
annotations.ce_understood_harm: It costs him whatever peace that false belief gave him
annotations.pda_responsibility: letting his hope stand in for the action I'm not taking

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five probably assume this track is empty, routine, unremarkable
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: Their trust in that assumption becomes the thing I quietly use
annotations.ce_understood_harm: it strips them of the caution they might have had otherwise
annotations.pda_responsibility: I feel the unfairness of using what they couldn't have known

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The lone worker seems, to my mind, to expect that whoever stands near
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expect that whoever stands near this lever would act
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I lean on that expectation to excuse my inaction
annotations.pda_responsibility: letting his trust carry the burden I should carry myself

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five, I think, trust this side is clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: trust this side is clear based on nothing but routine
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I use that unexamined trust to make my own decision less unbearable
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't feel right about it, but I don't see another way

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The single man probably believes someone will intervene before the end
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I let that belief serve me, easing my own hesitation
annotations.ce_understood_harm: it costs him a comfort he never should have had to spend
